issues.problem: NEW: 'Şimdi: WebGL su.' - 'WebGL su' is two bare nouns with no possession suffix, so it does not read as 'the WebGL water' the way en 'WebGL water' / ru 'WebGL-вода' do (Turkish needs the -su/-suyu possessed form in this compounds position). The sibling chips cartoonNow ('Şimdi: çizgi.') and swissNow ('Şimdi: Swiss.') are fine, so only this one is ungrammatical.
issues.fix: Şimdi: WebGL suyu. Çizgi için tıkla.
